description: Cross-language capability parity for minimalist-installer. Status values are equivalent | python-extension | node-extension | not-applicable.

features.notes: Three-hash classification and declarative file reconciliation.
Additive deep merge with structural array dedupe and delta-only revert.
Per-owner marker identity and last-owner reclaim semantics.
Frontmatter signature detection and reversible prune.
Two-tier config factory binding providers and built-in effects.
Python persists prepare/apply checkpoints in a WAL separate from the committed manifest.
SafeFilesystem refuses symlink/reparse traversal; platforms without a verified backend fail closed.
Declarative bundled host adapters with detection evidence and support tiers.
SkillDistribution planning, shared-destination dedupe, and variable rendering.
minimalist-installer console entry point plus optional Rich/Questionary TUI.
Node worked example under examples/symlink-runtime-layer.js; not shipped in the Python package.
JavaScript ESM exports and npm distribution surface.
Win32 safe mutation backend is intentionally unavailable until handle-relative traversal is verified; tests fail closed or skip.
